tooltip.godtechascension.god_sword: Right-Click: Unleashes an AoE Energy Slash (3s cooldown).
jei.godtechascension.info.titanium_ore: Generates underground between Y = -64 and Y = 32. Mine with an Iron Pickaxe or better to obtain Raw Titanium (affected by Fortune).
jei.godtechascension.info.titanium_casin: Industrial casing block crafted from Titanium Sheets, Iron Ingots, and Redstone. Used for high-tier builds and upcoming GodTech machines.
jei.godtechascension.info.raw_titanium: Mined from Titanium Ore. Smelt or blast into a Titanium Ingot, or combine with Flint to make Crushed Raw Titanium.
jei.godtechascension.info.crushed_raw_ti: Create-style crushed titanium intermediate. Smelt or blast into a Titanium Ingot.
jei.godtechascension.info.titanium_ingot: Refined from Raw Titanium or Crushed Raw Titanium. Craft 4 in a 2x2 grid for Titanium Sheets, or alloy with Iron and Copper for Titanium Alloy.
jei.godtechascension.info.titanium_sheet: Pressed industrial plate made from Titanium Ingots. Used to craft Titanium Casing and Reinforced Mechanisms.
jei.godtechascension.info.titanium_alloy: High-strength industrial alloy made from Iron, Titanium, and Copper. Required for Quantum Circuits, God Pickaxe, and God Sword.
jei.godtechascension.info.reinforced_mec: Precision mechanical assembly crafted from Titanium Sheets, Gold, Copper, and Redstone. Used in the God Pickaxe and advanced machines.
jei.godtechascension.info.god_crystal: Radiant energy crystal crafted from Diamond, Amethyst Shards, Blaze Powder, and Redstone. Core ingredient for Quantum Circuits and God Cores.
jei.godtechascension.info.void_shard: Condensed void material crafted from Obsidian, Ender Pearls, and Amethyst Shards. Used in the God Pickaxe and God Sword.
jei.godtechascension.info.quantum_circui: Advanced circuit board crafted from Redstone, Gold, Titanium Alloy, and a God Crystal. Used to craft the God Core.
jei.godtechascension.info.god_core: Endgame Ascension core crafted from God Crystals, Quantum Circuits, and a Nether Star. Powers the God Pickaxe and God Sword.
jei.godtechascension.info.god_pickaxe: Endgame pickaxe that mines a 3x3 area at once. Hold Sneak while mining to break a single 1x1 block.
jei.godtechascension.info.god_sword: Endgame blade. Right-click to unleash a 5-block AoE Energy Slash (3-second cooldown) that damages and knocks back nearby enemies.
